lines.en: label ramen25:
scene tsuneyogreenonion1
: Sigh.
: You’re not supposed to {i}say{/i} “sigh,” Tsuneyo. You’re supposed to just...actually do it.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，「唉」不是「{i}说{/i}」出来的。你应该……真的叹口气。

lines.en: : Sensei, when you look at this knife...what do you see?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你看着这把刀……看到了什么？

lines.en: : A knife.
lines.zh: : 一把刀。

lines.en: : Look closer.
lines.zh: : 再仔细看。

lines.en: scene tsuneyogreenonion2
: It’s still a knife.
lines.zh: : 还是一把刀。

lines.en: : Precisely.
lines.zh: : 正是。

lines.en: scene tsuneyogreenonion3
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Sometimes, what you see is what you get.
lines.zh: : 有时候，你看到的就是你得到的。

lines.en: : And other times, you get a knife.
lines.zh: : 而另一些时候，你得到的是一把刀。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, what the fuck are you talking about?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，你他妈到底在说什么？

lines.en: : Knives, idiot.
lines.zh: : 刀啊，白痴。

lines.en: : I had a thought, but it went somewhere else.
lines.zh: : 我本来有个想法，结果它跑到别的地方去了。

lines.en: : This would not be an issue if you were more entertaining.
lines.zh: : 如果你更有趣一点，就不会有这种问题了。

lines.en: : Well forgive me for coming all the way across town in the cold to spend time with you.
lines.zh: : 原谅我大冷天穿过整个镇子来陪你吧。

lines.en: : I can not forgive you. But I can make you a bowl of delicious soup that will warm both your heart and your soul.
lines.zh: : 我无法原谅你。但我可以给你做一碗美味的汤，温暖你的心与灵魂。

lines.en: As you can see, I decided to spend the night hanging out at Tojo Ramen with Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: 如你所见，我决定今晚来 Tojo Ramen 跟 Tsuneyo 待着。

lines.en: And despite the way she’s slowly waving a knife around, it’s clear that she is happy to see me.
lines.zh: 尽管她正慢慢挥着一把刀，但显然她很高兴见到我。

lines.en: Well, “happy” is probably a bit of an exaggeration.
lines.zh: 嗯，「高兴」大概有点夸张了。

lines.en: But she was just standing around before I got here and is now capable of doing her job- the one thing in life she appears to be confident in.
lines.zh: 不过我到来之前她只是站着发呆，现在却能干活了——那是她人生中唯一显得自信的事。

lines.en: : Just make me whatever you feel like making. I don’t care.
lines.zh: : 随便给我做点你想做的就行。我不挑。

lines.en: : I don’t feel like making anything. Are you okay with starving?
lines.zh: : 我什么都不想做。你饿着可以吗？

lines.en: : {i}You{/i} don’t feel like getting...closer to noodles or whatever?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}不想……离面条更近一点什么的？

lines.en: scene tsuneyogreenonion4
: I will not be told to get closer to Noodles by the one man who stays as far away from him as possible.
lines.zh: : 我可不会被这个离 Noodles 最远的男人指使着去靠近 Noodles。

lines.en: : Not bird-noodles. Noodles-noodles.
lines.zh: : 不是鸟-面条。是面条-面条。

lines.en: : It’s unlike you to not want to cook.
lines.zh: : 你不想做饭，这可不像你。

lines.en: scene tsuneyogreenonion5
: As a wise man once said...even the best fall down sometimes.
lines.zh: : 正如一位智者曾说……即便是最好的人，有时也会跌倒。

lines.en: : That wasn’t a wise man. That’s the chorus from Howie Day’s 2003 hit single, “Collide.”
lines.zh: : 那不是智者。那是 Howie Day 2003 年的热门单曲《Collide》的副歌。

lines.en: : And what a wise man he was.
lines.zh: : 那他真是个智者。

lines.en: : But who said it does not matter even half as much as {i}what{/i} was said, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 可是谁说的，远没有说了{i}什么{/i}重要，Sensei。

lines.en: : I’m afraid that I am just lacking the same motivation and excitement that you would normally come to expect from a lively, energetic girl like myself.
lines.zh: : 我恐怕只是缺少了你通常会从一个像我这样活泼有朝气的女孩身上期待到的动力与兴奋。

lines.en: : Yes. Because when I think of Tsuneyo Tojo, I immediately think “lively.”
lines.zh: : 是啊。因为一想到 Tsuneyo Tojo，我立刻想到的就是「活泼」。

lines.en: : If only I could be more like this knife.
lines.zh: : 要是我能更像这把刀就好了。

lines.en: : I know there’s a metaphor in there somewhere, but I’d appreciate it if you could just tell me what it is so I don’t have to use my brain.
lines.zh: : 我知道这里面有个什么比喻，不过你要是能直接告诉我，我就不用动脑子了。

lines.en: : Sharp. And made of steel. This is the me who never was. The me who is not.
lines.zh: : 锋利。钢做的。这是从未存在过的我。不存在的我。

lines.en: : If this is another comedy routine, I'm going to go ahead and do you a favor by asking you to scrap it.
lines.zh: : 如果这又是一段喜剧表演，那我先帮你个忙，建议你把它砍了。

lines.en: scene tsuneyogreenonion6
: Gone...like noodles in the wind. Flying about and causing destruction everywhere they roam.
lines.zh: : 消失了……像风中的面条。到处飞舞，所到之处一片狼藉。

lines.en: : This is the Tsuneyo Tojo you see before you. A shell of her former crab.
lines.zh: : 你眼前这位就是 Tsuneyo Tojo。只是昔日螃蟹的空壳。

lines.en: : What the hell happened to you overnight?
lines.zh: : 你一夜之间到底怎么了？

lines.en: scene tsuneyogreenonion7
: Is this what they call “depression?” Should I see a doctor?
lines.zh: : 这就是人们说的「抑郁」吗？我该去看医生吗？

lines.en: : I highly doubt that. Why don’t you just tell me what’s going on?
lines.zh: : 我非常怀疑。你干脆告诉我发生了什么吧？

lines.en: : I can’t guarantee that I can help or anything but, sometimes, talking about stuff is all you need to feel a little better.
lines.zh: : 我不能保证帮得上什么忙，不过有时候，把事情说出来就足以让你好受一点。

lines.en: : Also, if I’m on better terms with you, you won’t feel the urge to stab me with that knife you’re still waving around.
lines.zh: : 再说，要是我跟你关系好点，你也就不会总想用那把还在挥的刀捅我了。

lines.en: : How did you know about that urge? Did I mention it out loud in the heat of my sadness?
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道我有那个冲动？是我沉浸在悲伤中时说漏嘴了吗？

lines.en: You know, maybe I should call it an early night and head back home before Ami needs to identify my body at the local morgue?
lines.zh: 你知道吗，也许我该早点收工回家，免得待会儿 Ami 得去本地停尸房认我的尸体？

lines.en: : Just tell me what’s wrong. That’s the least you can do to make up for not serving me while you’re still open.
lines.zh: : 就说说你怎么了。你还在营业却不招待我，至少得这样补偿我。

lines.en: : It’s either that or I leave you a bad Yelp review.
lines.zh: : 不然我就给你留个差评。

lines.en: scene tsuneyogreenonion8
: Don’t you dare! Everyone knows that a restaurant’s success is entirely dependent on the thoughts of various inexperienced consumers who went through the effort of actually creating a Yelp account!
lines.zh: : 你敢！谁都知道，一家餐馆的成败，完全取决于那些费劲注册了 Yelp 账号、毫无经验的消费者的想法！

lines.en: : I shall turn {i}you{/i} into ramen, you bastard!
lines.zh: : 我要把{i}你{/i}做成拉面，你这混蛋！

lines.en: : Okay. On that note, I’m just going to-
lines.zh: : 好。既然如此，我就——

lines.en: scene tsuneyogreenonion1
: Fine. I will talk.
lines.zh: : 好。我说。

lines.en: : But it is very sad. Please do not cry when you hear how horrible things are.
lines.zh: : 可这非常悲伤。听到事情有多糟，请你别哭。

lines.en: : I’m sure that I’ve heard worse than whatever it is you’re going through.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定，比你正在经历的更糟的事我都听过。

lines.en: : Sigh.
: Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : It appears that the restaurant is out of green onions.
lines.zh: : 看来店里的青葱用完了。

lines.en: : Not to be mistaken with the Green Onion of the second floor. She has not yet come to this restaurant.
lines.zh: : 别跟二楼的青葱搞混了。她还没来过这家店。

lines.en: : And...that’s why you’re giving up on everything?
lines.zh: : 而……这就是你放弃一切的原因？

lines.en: : One item being out of stock is a symbol of my failure as the acting manager of this business.
lines.zh: : 一样东西缺货，是我作为本店代理店长失败的标志。

lines.en: : First, it is the green onions. Then, it is chopsticks.
lines.zh: : 先是青葱。然后是筷子。

lines.en: : Then, next thing I know, everyone has to grab their noodles with their fingers and eat them the way birds eat worms.
lines.zh: : 接着不知不觉间，所有人都得用手指抓面，像鸟啄虫子一样吃。

lines.en: : Sure. Except birds don’t have fingers and use their beaks to eat.
lines.zh: : 当然。不过鸟没有手指，是用喙吃的。

lines.en: scene tsuneyogreenonion8
: Oh, so {i}now{/i} you care about what birds do? How dare you?
lines.zh: : 哦，{i}现在{/i}你关心鸟怎么吃了？你胆子不小啊？

lines.en: : Is that really all that’s bothering you? Running out of one thing?
lines.zh: : 真的只是因为少了一样东西在困扰你？

lines.en: scene tsuneyogreenonion1
: I was prepared to adapt to the situation at first...
lines.zh: : 一开始我还准备随机应变……

lines.en: : But as the hours went by and no customers entered the store, I realized that my failure must have already spread throughout the city.
lines.zh: : 可时间一点点过去，一个客人也没进店，我意识到我的失败大概已经传遍全城了。

lines.en: : I’m afraid it is too late for me now.
lines.zh: : 恐怕对我来说已经太迟了。

lines.en: : No one’s come in all day?
lines.zh: : 一整天都没人进来？

lines.en: scene tsuneyogreenonion3
: If they have, they are either invisible or extremely sneaky. And not hungry.
lines.zh: : 如果有，那他们要么是隐形的，要么极其鬼祟。而且不饿。

lines.en: : We have experienced slow days in the past, but never anything like this.
lines.zh: : 我们以前也经历过冷清的日子，但从没有像今天这样。

lines.en: : Though, I am prepared to experience happiness once more if you offset the lack of profit by purchasing everything on the menu.
lines.zh: : 不过，如果你把菜单上所有东西都买一遍、弥补利润的缺口，我也准备好重新体验一次幸福了。

lines.en: : You know...I {i}would{/i}, but I was kind of hoping for something with green onions.
lines.zh: : 你知道……我{i}愿意{/i}，可我其实挺想要点带青葱的东西。

lines.en: scene tsuneyogreenonion9
: Of course. Another reminder of my inadequacy makes itself known before the doors are closed for the night.
lines.zh: : 当然。在夜幕落下、店门关上之前，又一记提醒我无能的打击出现了。

lines.en: : Tojo Ramen is no more. This is the end.
lines.zh: : Tojo Ramen 不复存在了。这就是结局。

lines.en: : Oh, stop being dramatic.
lines.zh: : 哦，别那么夸张。

lines.en: scene tsuneyogreenonion10
: Dramatic?! Me?! The world is crashing down right now and you have the audacity to demand such a thing?!
lines.zh: : 夸张？！我？！世界正在崩塌，你竟敢提出这种要求？！

lines.en: : Where do you get off?!
lines.zh: : 你凭什么？！

lines.en: : Jesus. There’s no need to yell.
lines.zh: : 天啊。没必要吼。

lines.en: scene tsuneyogreenonion3
: I apologize. I was attempting to show the difference between true drama and what you had labeled as drama, but my acting skills were so good that you must have gotten scared.
lines.zh: : 我道歉。我刚才想展示真正的戏剧性和你所谓的戏剧性之间的区别，结果我的演技太好，把你吓到了。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, you do realize there is a very easy way to solve your problem of not having onions, right?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，你知道没洋葱这个问题有个非常简单的解决办法，对吧？

lines.en: : I’m sure customers won’t magically appear again once you obtain them, but it’s not like they are out of reach forever.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定你一补到货，客人不会魔法般地出现，但洋葱又不是永远弄不到。

lines.en: : Not forever. But we do not receive our next shipment of produce until two days from now.
lines.zh: : 不是永远。可我们下一批农产品要两天后才送到。

lines.en: : It is highly probable that I will have to sell my body to make up for the loss in profit we face during this time.
lines.zh: : 我很可能不得不卖身，来弥补这段时间的利润损失。

lines.en: : There’s no way you’re losing that- wait.
lines.zh: : 你不可能损失那么多——等等。

lines.en: : For what? Why am I waiting?
lines.zh: : 等什么？我为什么要等？

lines.en: : Just out of curiosity...
lines.zh: : 只是好奇……

lines.en: : How much would you be selling it for?
lines.zh: : 你会卖多少钱？

lines.en: : I am not sure. I do not even know what the process of selling one’s body entails. I just know that it is meant to generate a great amount of revenue.
lines.zh: : 我不确定。我甚至不知道卖身的过程是什么样的。我只知道它能带来一大笔收入。

lines.en: : Oh. Well, uhh...that’s probably not an alternative you’ll have to worry about. Especially with this incredibly smart proposition I am about to...propose.
lines.zh: : 哦。嗯，呃……那个备选方案你大概不用操心。尤其是我接下来要……提议的这个绝顶聪明的方案。

lines.en: : If you are attempting to purchase me, I will give you a 5%% discount.
lines.zh: : 如果你想买下我，我可以给你 5% 的折扣。

lines.en: : A: Don’t even bother offering discounts that small. And B: Let’s go get you more green onions.
lines.zh: : 一：别费心提供这么小的折扣。二：我们去给你弄更多青葱吧。

lines.en: : Impossible. Produce delivery day is still 48 hours off. You are out of line, sir.
lines.zh: : 不可能。农产品配送日还有 48 小时。你太过分了，先生。

lines.en: : I’m telling you that you don’t have to wait. You can just go to the convenience store and buy enough to hold you over for a day or two.
lines.zh: : 我告诉你，你不必等。你可以直接去便利店买够撑一两天的量。

lines.en: : Aren’t you supposed to be amazing at this? I’m surprised you didn’t think of that.
lines.zh: : 你不是应该很擅长这个吗？我真惊讶你没想到。

lines.en: scene tsuneyogreenonion11
: It did not even occur to me.
lines.zh: : 我压根没想到。

lines.en: : I finally understand where the word {i}convenience{/i} in “convenience store” comes from.
lines.zh: : 我终于明白「便利店」里的「{i}便利{/i}」二字从何而来了。

lines.en: : They are able to operate outside the jurisdiction of the Produce Delivery Administration.
lines.zh: : 它们能在农产品配送管理局的管辖之外运作。

lines.en: : Yup. That’s exactly why they are called that.
lines.zh: : 对。所以才叫这个名字。

lines.en: : The only issue is that you’ll have to close the store while you’re out so people don’t wind up coming in and robbing the place.
lines.zh: : 唯一的问题是，你出去的时候得关店，免得有人进来把店里洗劫一空。

lines.en: scene tsuneyogreenonion1
: That is a fair price to pay. It is not as if anyone will enter the restaurant when it already reeks of failure to begin with.
lines.zh: : 这是合理的代价。反正这地方早就弥漫着失败的气味，也不会有人进来。

lines.en: : Now, we just need to locate one of the stores.
lines.zh: : 现在，我们只需要找一家店。

lines.en: : There’s one that Noriko works at not far from here. We can just go there.
lines.zh: : 离这儿不远有家 Noriko 上班的店。我们去那儿就行。

lines.en: scene tsuneyogreenonion11
: Another convenience. Things are already beginning to turn around.
lines.zh: : 又一件便利的事。事情已经开始好转了。

lines.en: : Please give me a moment to check with my father and see if such a task is allowed.
lines.zh: : 请给我一点时间，去问问父亲是否允许这么做。

lines.en: : Do you really need permission? Aren’t you in charge of the place while he’s...sick?
lines.zh: : 你真需要许可吗？他……生病期间，不是你说了算吗？

lines.en: scene tsuneyogreenonion3
: I am also worried that this may be a trap and that you are going to kidnap me and throw me into traffic.
lines.zh: : 我还担心这是个陷阱，你会绑架我、把我扔到车流里。

lines.en: : That’s not what human trafficking means, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 人口贩卖不是那个意思，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : That may just be what you want me to think.
lines.zh: : 那也许正是你想让我这么以为的。

lines.en: : I will return shortly.
lines.zh: : 我很快就回来。

lines.en: : Please help yourself to some chopsticks while you wait.
lines.zh: : 等待期间请自取筷子。

lines.en: scene black
: And do...{i}what{/i} with them?...
lines.zh: : 然后拿它们……做{i}什么{/i}？……

lines.en: scene tsuneyogreenonion12
Tsuneyo returns downstairs several minutes later and proceeds to shut off a bunch of the equipment in the restaurant.
lines.zh: 几分钟后 Tsuneyo 回到楼下，接着关掉了店里的一堆设备。

lines.en: It looks like she got permission to just close entirely rather than temporarily.
lines.zh: 看来她得到许可，可以直接关门，而不是临时歇业。

lines.en: Now that I think about it, I’m not even really sure what time Tojo Ramen stays open until.
lines.zh: 现在想想，我甚至不太确定 Tojo Ramen 营业到几点。

lines.en: But given the fact that I was their first customer of the day on account of the invisible, yet noticeable aura of Tsuneyo’s “failure,” I can’t imagine anyone else was coming tonight.
lines.zh: 不过考虑到——拜 Tsuneyo 那股隐形却明显的「失败」气场所赐——我是他们今天的第一个客人，我想今晚也不会有别人来了。

lines.en: We make our way through the old district as a series of homeless, decrepit onlookers gaze at us with a mix of curiosity and what could only be interpreted as desperation.
lines.zh: 我们穿过旧城区，一路上无家可归、衰老破败的旁观者盯着我们，眼神里混杂着好奇与只能被解读为绝望的东西。

lines.en: What they’re desperate {i}for{/i}, I have no clue.
lines.zh: 他们「{i}渴望{/i}」着什么，我毫无头绪。

lines.en: But I try not to think about it because...
lines.zh: 但我尽量不去想，因为……

lines.en: Well, it’s fucking creepy.
lines.zh: 嗯，那实在太他妈瘆人了。

lines.en: : I have never walked around this area at night before.
lines.zh: : 我从没在晚上走过这一带。

lines.en: : It is quite different than it is during the day.
lines.zh: : 跟白天完全不同。

lines.en: : The people seem rather lively.
lines.zh: : 这些人看起来相当有生气。

lines.en: scene tsuneyogreenonion13
: {i}This{/i} is lively to you?
lines.zh: : 这就叫「{i}有生气{/i}」？

lines.en: : Compared to normal, I would say yes.
lines.zh: : 跟平常比，我会说是。

lines.en: : Though these villagers likely lack both the physical and mental fortitude they possessed when they were younger, you can still sense the curiosity dwelling within them.
lines.zh: : 虽然这些村民大概已经失去了年轻时的体力与心力，你依然能感觉到他们心里住着的好奇。

lines.en: : I mean, it’s not really “sensing” it if they’re looking right at us.
lines.zh: : 我说，他们明明就在直勾勾看着我们，那算不上「感觉」。

lines.en: : Where else would you ask they look instead?
lines.zh: : 那你要他们看哪儿？

lines.en: : It is not a crime to simply watch.
lines.zh: : 只是看着并不犯罪。

lines.en: : That kind of depends on what you’re watching, I think.
lines.zh: : 那要看你在看什么，我觉得。

lines.en: : If you spend too much time looking down on how others look at you, you will miss out on many of the beautiful things life has to offer.
lines.zh: : 如果你花太多时间嫌弃别人看你的方式，就会错过生活里许多美好的东西。

lines.en: : Branches...Leaves...The wide part...
lines.zh: : 树枝……树叶……那宽宽的部分……

lines.en: : Those are all just different parts of a tree. I’m sure there is more in life that you think is beautiful.
lines.zh: : 那都是树的不同部位。我相信你觉得生活里美好的东西不止这些。

lines.en: scene tsuneyogreenonion14
: Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : Those are just the first things that came to mind.
lines.zh: : 那只是最先想到的。

lines.en: : My father has always kept trees close to his heart, so I assume I inherited that love from him.
lines.zh: : 我父亲一直把树放在心上，所以我想这份热爱是从他那里继承来的。

lines.en: : And these people- the ones staring at us as we venture forth toward produce-
lines.zh: : 而这些人——我们去找农产品时盯着我们的那些——

lines.en: : Even they are more lively than he is now.
lines.zh: : 他们甚至比他现在更有生气。

lines.en: : They can stand...and speak without the assistance of a machine.
lines.zh: : 他们能站着……能不靠机器说话。

lines.en: : I knew he couldn’t walk, but...he can’t speak anymore either?
lines.zh: : 我知道他走不了路，可是……他也说不了话了？

lines.en: : Not the way you and I can.
lines.zh: : 不是你和我这样的说法。

lines.en: : We are special. Gifted, even.
lines.zh: : 我们是特别的。甚至是有天赋的。

lines.en: : But one day, that gift will be taken away from us.
lines.zh: : 但总有一天，这份天赋会从我们身上被夺走。

lines.en: : And we will wish in those final moments that we had not pushed so many of life’s beauties aside.
lines.zh: : 而在最后的那些时刻，我们会希望自己当初没有把那么多生活的美好推到一边。

lines.en: : So do not look at these people with unease clouding your mind. Look at them as worse or older versions of us.
lines.zh: : 所以别带着不安看这些人。把他们看成更差的、更老的我们。

lines.en: : You do realize that way of wording it sounds even worse than the one I used, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道这种说法听起来比我那句还糟吧？

lines.en: scene tsuneyogreenonion15
: I would rather be acknowledged as a worse version of someone else than not acknowledged at all.
lines.zh: : 我宁愿被当作别人的更差版本，也不愿根本不被当回事。

lines.en: : Meet with your fears and learn that they are nothing worth fearing at all.
lines.zh: : 去直面你的恐惧，你会发现它们根本不值得害怕。

lines.en: : Do not avert your gaze. For they will stop existing the moment you wish them to.
lines.zh: : 别移开目光。因为只要你希望它们消失，它们就不再存在。

lines.en: : Keep them alive. Because it is possible that one day, you will be in their shoes...
lines.zh: : 让它们活着。因为说不定有一天，你会站在他们的位置上……

lines.en: : Staring at a man and a woman making their way down the street- remembering when that used to be you.
lines.zh: : 盯着街上一男一女走过——回忆起那也曾是你。

lines.en: : So, when do I get to meet your father?
lines.zh: : 那么，我什么时候能见见你父亲？

lines.en: : I do not think you ever will.
lines.zh: : 我想你永远见不到。

lines.en: : Why not? That whole speech made it sound like you really want old people to be happy for whatever reason.
lines.zh: : 为什么？你刚才那番话听起来像是你非常希望老人们能开心，不管什么原因。

lines.en: : And, who knows? Maybe he’d like my company?
lines.zh: : 再说，谁知道呢？也许他会喜欢有我作伴？

lines.en: : My father is a man full of pride.
lines.zh: : 我父亲是个自尊心极强的人。

lines.en: : He does not wish to be seen in his current state.
lines.zh: : 他不愿被人看到自己现在的样子。

lines.en: : So, unless that changes, I will respect his wishes and continue to deliver quality noodle dishes to all of his loyal customers when I am not too busy failing them.
lines.zh: : 所以除非这点改变，否则我会尊重他的意愿，在不忙着让他的忠实顾客失望的时候，继续为他们奉上优质的面食。

lines.en: : Well, here’s hoping that obtaining the {i}one{/i} missing ingredient in your store is enough to magically remind everyone that you exist again.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那就希望补上你店里缺的这{i}一样{/i}食材，能神奇地让所有人重新想起你的存在。

lines.en: : Thanks, bro.
lines.zh: : 谢了，兄弟。

lines.en: : If that does not work, I will look further into the process of body sales.
lines.zh: : 如果那不管用，我会进一步研究一下卖身的流程。

lines.en: : Sure. As long as I’m the first person who gets a quote.
lines.zh: : 好。只要我第一个拿到报价。

lines.en: : You already received a quote earlier. From the wise man, Howard Daylight.
lines.zh: : 你早些时候已经拿到报价了。出自智者 Howard Daylight 之口。

lines.en: : Not...that kind of...
lines.zh: : 不是……那种……

lines.en: scene black
: Oh, fuck it.
lines.zh: : 哦，去他的。
